Key Lime Cheesecake
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:54pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 pkt Graham crackers, crushed
6 tablespoons Butter, melted
 cup Sugar
24 ounces Cream cheese, unwrapped and softened in a microwave on high
5 Jumbo eggs, separated
3/4 cup Sugar
2 env Knox gelatin
1/2 cup Light rum
 cup Key lime juice
2 teaspoons Fresh grated lime peel
1 pint Whipping cream
3 dsh Green food coloring, more or less

Preparation

1 Crust: Mix and pat into bottom and Springform pan Bake at 350 for 10 mins. 2 FILLING: Soften gelatin in small saucepan with 1/2 cup water. Stir egg yolks into 1/2 cup sugar. Add to gelatin mixture with lime juice and peel and cook over med. heat. stirring constantly until mixture thickens and bubbles. Cool. Beat cheese in large bowl until light an fluffy. Slowly add gelatin mixture and blend well. Add food coloring and mix well. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Add remaining 1/4 cup sugar and continue beating until stiff peaks form.
